## Bug report

**Required Info:**

- Operating System:
  - Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS
- Computer:
  - Intel Core 7 240H (16 threads), 32 GB RAM
- ROS2 Version:
  - Jazzy and navigation2 built from source
- Version or commit hash:
  - main 20b9fa3e
- DDS implementation:
  - rmw_zenoh_cpp

#### Steps to reproduce issue

I added a gtest that produces the issue in [this branch](https://github.com/odemirs/navigation2/tree/bug-report-navigator-update-goal)

Additional test in the branch runs `bt_navigator` with a `NavigateThroughPoses` tree that only sleeps. A
`NavigateThroughPosesAction` client sets `goal_updated_` while its goal is running, so
`BtActionNode` sends the same goal again.

#### Expected behavior

No NavigatorMuxer error print. Since, preempting a goal with the same navigator should be valid.

#### Actual behavior

On goal update `bt_navigator` logs:

```
[NavigatorMutex]: Major error! Navigation requested while another navigation task is in progress!
This likely occurred from an incorrect implementation of a navigator plugin.
```

Navigation continues normally.

#### Reproduction instructions

```
git clone -b bug-report-navigator-update-goal --depth 1 https://github.com/odemirs/navigation2.git
cd navigation2
colcon build --packages-select nav2_bt_navigator --cmake-args -DBUILD_TESTING=ON
./build/nav2_bt_navigator/test/test_navigate_through_poses_goal_update
```

#### Additional information

Is it the desired behavior? Since, it can be fixed simply by checking `current_navigator_ == navigator` in `NavigatorMuxer::startNavigating` of behavior_tree_navigator.hpp . If new goal started with the current navigator, it should not print the error log message mentioned above.
new_candidates.title: False NavigatorMutex error on goal update with the same navigator
